sources.observation: The README describes a C++20/MIT direct DWG parser and 2D renderer with an R2000-R2018 version-family list. PROJECT_STATUS identifies itself as historical and superseded by V1.0.0-PLAN; it reports old metrics, names LibreDWG DWG-to-DXF and ezdxf entity extraction as differential references, and cites LibreDWG implementation details in parser decisions. The reviewed scope does not document ACIS 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY semantics, DWG AcDs owner association, or B-rep validation.

The current README labels DWG experimental but says its current DWG route is guidance to export to DXF. The documented converter uses the npm dxf parser and lists an explicit DXF subset including 3DFACE and SOLID; it does not document a native DWG parser or ACIS 3DSOLID semantic route.
